headline: Teamsters contract approval, vehicle purchase, and bill adjustment request for 142 Piave St, Pawtucket.
summary: The meeting covers a proposed Teamsters contract, a vehicle purchase, and a bill adjustment request for 142 Piave St. It also includes a consent agenda, an executive session on collective bargaining, and public input.

New business: Teamsters proposed contract approval

Announcement: Next scheduled meeting on September 8th, 2026
